editorNote: Security leads the day. Epoch AI says public patches can now be turned into working exploits before users update, and a backdoored Anthropic VS Code extension on Cursor sat live for nearly 12 hours. If you run either, check installs and shorten patch windows. Separately, major AI companies are backing a shared way for sites to opt out of scraping.
